ITEM 1 | Orange-colored cooked carrot pieces, glossy with a slight sheen and soft-looking, roughly 7-8 cm long sticks and rounded chunks, some halved lengthwise with cut faces visible, slightly caramelized edges, clustered in the upper-left portion of a white square plate and covering roughly 20% of the plate surface, piled about 2-3 cm high | 110
ITEM 2 | Plain white cooked rice, moist and slightly clumped with separate loose grains, fluffy texture with some visible grain separation, a few pale yellowish grains mixed in, mounded on the right side of the plate covering roughly 25% of the plate surface and about 2-2.5 cm high, sitting directly on the white plate next to the carrots | 170
